text:
Jordan M.: heads-up: discovered a parity problem between node and python SDKs for embeddings+rerank when batch_helper is on. node returns fewer items after a sub-batch retry.

Leila P.: can you paste a minimal repro? sounds like a merge-by-index bug.

Jordan M.: repro: send 7 inputs with batch_helper.max_batch_size=4. node does (4,3). server 500s on second sub-batch, node retries, final node payload has 6 embeddings, python has 7.

Owen C.: node helper uses positional concat to avoid per-item ids; python tags items with uuids. retry + truncated response can drop items with pos-merge.

Jordan M.: exact. enabling tag_ids in node fixed it.

Leila P.: short-term guidance: set batch_helper.tag_ids=true or disable helper. long-term: change node helper to auto-tag when retry/backoff configured.

InfraBot: Created DEVEX-4510: "node: auto-enable batch item ids when retry/backoff configured"  https://rwd.in/DEVEX-4510

Owen C.: also raises response shape inconsistency: node returns parallel arrays (embeddings + meta) while python returns list-of-objects. propose opt-in header response_shape=object_items then migrate defaults after releases.

Leila P.: agree. add server meta field dedupe_count to help detect dropped items quickly.

Jordan M.: will add a tiny repro snippet to the ticket and test include_input=true + tag_ids=true. thanks for quick triage.
